definitions.explanation: A foam insulation material made from polyurethane, sprayed or placed to fill gaps. Offers high insulation performance and good airtightness.

examples.japanese: {隙間|すきま}にウレタンフォームを{吹|ふ}き{付|つ}ける。
examples.english: Spray urethane foam into the gaps.

examples.japanese: ウレタンフォームは{断熱|だんねつ}{性能|せいのう}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Urethane foam has high insulation performance.

examples.japanese: {現場|げんば}でウレタンフォームを{吹|ふ}き{付|つ}けると、{複雑|ふくざつ}な{形状|けいじょう}の{隙間|すきま}もふさげる。
examples.english: Spraying urethane foam on-site can seal even oddly shaped gaps.

notes:
A loanword from English "urethane foam." Sprayed foam insulation that expands to fill gaps, giving strong airtightness and high insulation per thickness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ウレタンフォームを{吹|ふ}き{付|つ}ける: to spray urethane foam
- {硬質|こうしつ}ウレタンフォーム: rigid urethane foam

SIMILAR WORDS:
- グラスウール: glass wool — cheaper, must be fitted carefully
- セルロースファイバー: cellulose fiber — recycled-paper based, blown in
